method.affected_rule: A building is affected when its OSM footprint centroid lies inside the satellite hazard footprint (same rule as the loss summary). Lines are clipped to the footprint; facilities use their point/centroid.

damage_classes.newly_flooded: Inside the mapped hazard footprint (new water vs baseline)
damage_classes.edge_contact: Outline overlaps the footprint but centroid lies outside — not counted as affected
damage_classes.persistent_water: Centroid in water present in both scenes — not counted
damage_classes.none: Within 200 m of the footprint, not affected

method.height: OSM `height` tag when present; otherwise OSM `building:levels` × 3 m per storey; otherwise an estimated default of 1 storey × 3 m = 3 m (height_source = 'estimated_default').
method.flood_depth: Unknown — Sentinel-1/2 map water extent, not depth; extrusion is building height, not water level.
